author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Gladiator stands the test of time as one of the most memorable depictions of the Roman Empire on film, thanks in no small part to the look established by production designer Arthur Max. At the Academy Library, Adam looks through concept drawings and Colosseum plans from the the production of Gladiator, including early designs for its titular combatants. 

Learn more about the Academy Museum and its collection at https://www.academymuseum.org/ and https://www.academycollection.org/
Learn more about the Academy Library at https://www.oscars.org/library

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
